name: Anime Card Farm
creator: Anime Card Factory
redeem: Launch Anime Card Farm on Roblox and wait for your farm to load.
Click the Shop button on the left side of the screen.
Scroll all the way to the bottom of the Shop to find the code box.
Type the code, including any exclamation mark, and press Redeem.
notes:
Anime Card Farm is a card collecting tycoon from the Anime Card Factory group, released on Roblox in May 2026. You buy card packs, open them to reveal anime cards, and place those cards on your farm where they earn money. Cards can be upgraded to earn more, rare mutated cards add big boosts, and your packs keep opening and making money while you are offline.

Its codes mostly give potions, such as Cash, Luck, Time and Mutation Potions, plus Trait Gems and the odd Trade Ticket. Luck Potions help the most early on, since they raise your odds of pulling rarer cards. New codes tend to show up with big updates, like-goals and apologies for downtime, and they are posted first in the game's Discord.

codes.reward: Time, Cash and Luck Potions, 200 Trait Gems and 200 Gems
1 Time II Potion and 100 Trait Gems
1 Cash Potion, 1 Luck Potion and 1 Mutation Potion

faq.q: Why won't my Anime Card Farm code work?
faq.a: Most codes here end with an exclamation mark, like TRADING!, and the game needs it. Copy the whole code with the punctuation and no extra spaces.
Trait Gems let you reroll the traits on your cards, which can boost damage, luck or cash output. The TRAITS! and BRUTALCOMEBACK! codes both give some.

faq.q: Where is the code box in Anime Card Farm?
faq.a: Open the Shop from the button on the left side of the screen and scroll to the very bottom. The code box and Redeem button are there.
